€1Ā. (बंहते, बंहित) To increase, grow. -Caus. 
__1 To increase. 
__2 To strengthen, make firm, fix.

a. 
__1 Most abundant, very great, excessive; (superl. of बहुल q. v.). 
__2 Very low or deep.

a. 
__1 More numerous or abundant, much more, exceeding; (compar. of बहुल q. v.). 
__2 Very stout or fat.
See वन्दिन्. A bard, herald; धर्मच्छेदात् पटुतरगिरो बन्दिनो नीलकण्ठाः [[

बन्दिः,
 
-न्दी f. 
__1 Bondage, confinement. 
__2 A prisoner, captive; मोक्ष्यते सुरबन्दीनां वेणीर्वीर्यविभूतिभिः [[

.]] 
-Comp. 
-ग्रहः taking prisoner, capture. 
-ग्राहः a house breaker, robber. 
-पालः a jailor. 
-शूला a harlot, prostitute. 
-स्थित a. imprisoned.

€9P. (बध्नाति, बबन्ध, अभांत्सीत्, भंत्स्यति, बन्द्धुम्, बद्ध; pass. बध्यते) 
__1 To bind, tie, fasten; बन्द्धुं न संभावित एव ताबत् करेण रुद्धोऽपि च केशपाशः [[

.]] 
__2 To catch, capture, imprison, ensnare, make captive; कर्मभिर्न स बध्यते [[

]]; 14. 56. 
__3 To chain, fetter. 
__4 To check, stop, suppress; as in बद्धकोप, बद्धकोष्ठ &c. 
__5 To put on, wear; न हि चूडामणिः पादे प्रभवामीति बध्यते [[

.]] 
__6 To attract, arrest (as eyes &c.); बबन्ध चक्षूंषि यवप्ररोहः [[

.]] 
__7 To fix or set upon, direct towards (as the eyes or mind), cast upon (with loc.); दृष्टिं लक्ष्येषु बध्नन् [[

.]] 
__8 To bind or fasten together (as hair); पूर्णप्रतिज्ञेन [Page1150-2] मया केवल बध्यते शिखा [[

.]] 
__9 To build, construct, form, arrange; बद्धोर्मिनाकवनितापरिभुक्तमुक्तम् [[

.]] 
__10 To put together, compose, construct (a poem, verse &c.); तुष्टैर्बद्धं तदलघु रघुस्वामिनः सच्चरित्रम् [[

.]] 
__11 To form, produce, bear (as fruit &c.); काले खलु समारब्धाः फलं बध्नन्ति नीतयः [[

]] (v. l.) [[Ś. 6. 3.]] 
__12 To have, possess, entertain, cherish, feel. 
__13 To punish, chastise. 
__14 To offer, sacrifice (as an animal). 
__15 To shut, close, stop. 
__16 To oppress, overpower. 
__17 To join, unite. 
__18 To produce, cause, effect. 
__19 To strike (as root). 
__20 To display, exhibit, show. (The senses of बन्ध् are variously modified according to the noun with which it is connected; e. g. भ्रुकुटिं बन्ध् to knit or bend the eyebrows, to frown; मुष्टिं बन्ध् to clench the fist; अञ्जलिं बन्ध् to fold the hands together in supplication; चित्तं, धियं, मनः, हृदयं बन्ध् to set the heart on; प्रीतिं, भावं, रागं बन्ध् to fall in love with, be enamoured of; सेतुं बन्ध् to construct or build a bridge; वैरं बन्ध् to conceive hatred, contract enmity; सख्यं, सौहृदं बन्ध् to form friendship; गोलं बन्ध् to form a globe; मण्डलं बन्ध् to form a circle, sit or stand in a circle; मौनं बन्ध् to maintain silence; परिकरं, कक्षां बन्ध् to gird up one's loins, prepare oneself for any thing; see the compounds under बद्ध also). -Caus. To cause to bind, form, construct, build &c.; स सेतुं बन्धयामास प्लवगैर्लवणाम्भसि [[

[बन्ध्-घञ्] 
__1 A tie, bond (in general) (आशाबन्ध &c.). 
__2 A hair-band, fillet; रतिविगलितबन्धे केशहस्ते सुकेश्याः (सति) [[
]]; अधार्मिकं त्रिभिर्न्यायैर्निगृह्णीयात् प्रयत्नतः । निरोधनेन बन्धेन विबिधेन वधेन च ॥ [[

.]] 
__5 Catching, capturing, catching hold of; गजबन्ध [[

.]] 
___(b) Building, erecting. 
__7 Feeling, conceiving, cherishing; [Page1151-2] हे राजानस्त्यजत सुकबिप्रेमबन्धे विरोधम् [[

.]] 
__8 Connection, union, intercourse. 
__9 Joining or folding together, combining; प्रासादवातायनदृश्यबन्धैः साकेतनार्योऽञ्जलिभिः प्रणेमुः [[

]]; अञ्जलिबन्धः &c. 
__10 A bandage, ligature. 
__11 Agreement, harmony. 
__12 Manifestation, display, exhibition; मनसिजतरुपुष्पं रागबन्धप्रबालम् (यौवनम्) [[

.]] 
__13 Bondage, confinement to this world (opp. मुक्ति which is ‘complete emancipation from the trammels of the world’); बन्धं मोक्षं च या वेत्ति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी [[

]], 59. 
__16 A particular position in sexual intercourse, or a particular mode of sexual enjoyment (these are said in Ratimañjarī to be 16, but other writers increase the number to 84). 
__17 A border, frame-work. 
__18 Arrangement of a stanza in a particular shape; e. g. खङ्गबन्ध, पद्मबन्ध, मुरजबन्ध (vide [[K.

]] ad loc). 
__19 A sinew, tendon. 
__20 The body. 
__21 A deposit, pledge. 
__22 An embankment, throwing a bridge across (a river). 
__23 A disease in which the eyelids cannot he wholly closed. 
-Comp. 
-करणम् fettering, imprisoning. 
-कर्तृ m. a binder, fetterer. 
-तन्त्रम् a complete army containing the four necessary elements, i. e. elephants, horses, chariots and footmen. 
-नृत्यम् a kind of dance. 
-पारुष्यम् forced or unnatural construction of words. 
-मुद्रा impression or mark of fetters. 
-स्तम्भः a post to which an animal (e. g. an elephant) is tied.

__1 One who binds or catches, a binder. 
__2 A catcher. 
__3 A band, tie, rope, tether. 
__4 A dike, bank, dam. 
__5 A pledge, deposit. 
__6 A posture of the body. 
__7 Barter, exchange. 
__8 A violator, ravisher. 
__9 A promise. 
__10 A city. 
__11 A part or portion (at the end of num. compounds); ऋणं सदशबन्धकम् [[

.]] 
-कम् 
__1 Binding, confinement. 
__2 Pawn, mortgage; [[L. D. B.]] 
-की 
__1 An unchaste woman; न मे त्बया कौमारबन्धक्या प्रयोजनम् [[

.]] 
__2 A harlot, courtezan; अतः परं स्बैरिणी स्याद्बन्धकी पञ्चमे भबेत् [[

.]] 
__3 A female elephant. 
__4 A barren woman.

a. 
__1 Binding, fettering. 
__2 Checking, stopping. 
__3 (At the end of comp.) Dependent upon; cf. निबन्धन. 
-नम् [बन्ध्-भावे-ल्युट्] 
__1 The act of binding, fastening, tying; स्मरसि स्मर मेखलागुणैरुत गोत्रस्खलितेषु बन्धनम् [[

.]] 
__2 Binding on or round, throwing round, clasping; विनम्रशाखाभुजबन्धनानि [[

]]; आशाबन्धनम् &c. 
__4 Fettering, chaining, confining. गजभुजङ्गमयोरपि बन्धनम् [[

.]] 
__5 A chain, fetter, tether, halter &c. 
__6 Capturing, catching. 
__7 Bondage, confinement, imprisonment, captivity; as in [Page1152-1] बन्धनागार. 
__8 A place of confinement, prison, jail; वसुदेवस्य देवक्यां जातो भोजेन्द्रबन्धने [[
]]; त्वां कारयामि कमलोदरबन्धनस्थम् [[Ś. 6. 20]]; द्विगुणं त्रिगुणं पश्चाद्यावज्जीवं तु बन्धनम् [[Śukra. 4. 80]]; [[

.]] 
__10 Connecting, uniting, joining. 
__11 Hurting, injuring. 
__12 A stalk, stem, peduncle (of a flower); कृतं न कर्णार्पितबन्धनं सखे [[Ś. 6. 18.]]; [[

.]] 
__13 A sinew, muscle; संधिन्नसंधिः प्रविकीर्णबन्धनो हतः क्षितौ वायुसुतेन राक्षसः [[

]]; 5. 24. 40. 
__14 A bandage. 
__15 A bar, barrier. 
__16 Alloyage, mixing. 
__17 An embankment, a bridge. 
__18 A conjunction, connection. 
__19 (In phil.) Mundane bondage (opp. to liberation). 
-नम्, -नी 
__1 A bond, tie. 
__2 A rope, cord. 
__3 A string, thread. 
__4 A chain, fetter. 
__5 A bondage. 
-Comp. 
-अ (आ) गारः, -रम्, -आलयः a prison, jail. 
-ग्रन्थिः 
__1 the knot of a bandage. 
__2 a noose. 
__3 a rope for tying cattle. 
-पालकः, -रक्षिन् m. a jailor. 
-वेश्मन् n. a prison. 
-स्थः a captive, prisoner. 
-स्तम्भः a tying-post, a post to which an animal (e. g. an elephant) is tied. 
-स्थानम् a stable, stall (for horses &c.).

[बन्ध-इत्र] 
__1 The god of love. 
__2 A leathern fan (चर्मव्यजन). 
__3 A spot, mole.

[बध्नाति मनः स्नेहादिना बन्ध्-उ] 
__1 A relation, kinsman, relative in general; यत्र द्रुमा अपि मृगा अपि बन्धबो मे [[

.]] 
__2 Any one connected or associated with another, a brother; प्रबासबन्धुः a brother-traveller; धर्मबन्धुः a spiritual brother; अनुमतगमना शकुन्तला तरुभिरियं वनवासबन्धुभिः [[Ś. 4. 10.]] 
__3 (In law) A cognate kinsman, one's own kindred or kinsmen generally; (three kinds are enumerated:-- आत्म° personal, पितृ° paternal, and मातृ° maternal; see these three words). 
__4 A friend (in general); as in बन्धुकृत्य below; oft. at the end of comp.; मकरन्दगन्धबन्धो [[

]] ‘a friend of, (i. e.) charged with fragrance’ &c.; 9. 13. 
__5 A husband; वैदेहिबन्धोर्हृदयं विदद्रे [[

.]] 
__6 A father. 
__7 A mother. 
__8 A brother. 
__9 The tree called बन्धुजीब q. v. 
__10 One who belongs to or is connected with any tribe or profession only nominally; i. e. one who belongs to it, but does not do the duties pertaining thereto (often used by way of contempt); स्वयमेव ब्रह्मबन्धुनोद्भिन्नो दुर्गप्रयोगः [[

]]; cf. क्षत्रबन्धु. 
__11 Connection, relationship, association in general; समुद्र एबास्य बन्धुः [[Bṛ.

.]] 
__13 (In astrol.) N. of the 3rd mansion. 
-Comp. 
-काम [Page1152-2] a. affectionate towards kinsmen. 
-कृत्यम् 
__1 the duty of a kinsman; त्वयि तु परिसमाप्तं बन्धुकृत्यं प्रजानाम् [[Ś. 5. 8.]] 
__2 the business of a friend, a friendly or kind act or service; काच्चित् सौम्य व्यवसितमिदं बन्धुकृत्यं त्वया मे [[

.]] 
-जनः 
__1 a relative, kinsman. 
__2 kindred, kinsmen taken collectively. 
-जीवः, -जीवकः N. of a tree; दृश्यन्ते बन्धुजीवाश्च श्यामाश्च गिरिसानुषु [[

.]] 
-दग्धः an abandoned wretch (हतक). 
-दत्तम् a kind of Strīdhana or woman's property, the property given to a girl by her relatives at the time of marriage; बन्धुदत्तं तथा शुल्कमन्वाधेयकमेव च [[

]]; बान्धबा भ्रातरो बन्धुदत्तप्रदेन कन्यादशायां यत् पितृभ्यां दत्तं तदुच्यते [[Dāy. B.]] 
-दायादः kinsman and heir; [[

.]] -a. entitled to inheritance by relationship. 
-प्रिय a. dear to friends or relations. 
-प्रीतिः f. 
__1 love of a relative; बन्धुप्रीत्या [[

]] (v. l.). 
__2 love for a friend. 
-भावः 
__1 friendship. 
__2 relationship. 
-वर्गः kinsmen, kindred. 
-हीन a. destitute of relatives or friends.

__1 The tree called बन्धुजीव. 
__2 A bastard. 
-का, -की An unchaste woman (see बन्धकी).

[बन्ध्-ऊक] N. of a tree; तबकरनिकरेण स्पष्टबन्धूकसूनस्तबकरचितमेते शेखरं बिभ्रतीव [[Śi. 11. 46]]; [[Ṛs. 3. 5.]] 
-कम् A flower of this tree; बन्धूकद्युतिबान्धवोऽयमधरः [[
__1 Relatives, kinsmen, kindred (taken collectively); प्रेयो मित्रं बन्धुता बा समग्रा [[

.]] 
__5 Deaf. 
__6 Injurious, mischievous. 
-रः 
__1 A goose. 
__2 A crane. 
__3 A drug. 
__4 An oil-cake. 
__5 The vulva. 
__6 The बन्धुजीब tree. 
-राः -m. (pl.) Parched corn or meal thereof. 
-रा An unchaste woman. 
-रम् 
__1 A diadem. 
__2 A band, rope; पञ्चबन्धुरम् (रथम्) [[

a. [बन्ध्-ऊरच्] 
__1 Undulating, uneven. 
__2 Bent, inclined, bowed. 
__3 Pleasing, delightful, lovely; cf. बन्धुर. 
-रम् A hole, chasm.

a. [बन्ध्-उलच्] 
__1 Bent, curved, inclined. 
__2 Pleasing, delightful, attractive, beautiful. 
-लः 
__1 A bastard; परगृहललिताः परान्नपुष्टाः परपुरुषैर्जनिताः पराङ्गनासु । परधननिरता गुणेष्वबाच्या गजकलभा इव बन्धुला ललामः [[

__1 To make a friend of. 
__2 To bring into connection with.

[बन्ध्-यत्] 
__1 To be bound or fettered, to be confined or imprisoned; अबन्ध्यं यश्च बध्नाति बद्धं यश्च प्रमुञ्चति [[

.]] 
__2 To be joined or bound together. 
__3 To be formed, built or constructed. 
__4 Detained, under arrest. 
__5 ( = वन्ध्य) Barren, unproductive, fruitless, useless (said of persons or things); बन्ध्यश्रमास्ते [[

.]] 
__6 Not having the menses or menstrual discharge. 
__7 (At the end of comp.) Deprived or destitute of. 
-Comp. 
-फल a. useless, vain, idle.

(= वन्ध्या) 
__1 A barren woman; न हि बन्ध्या बिजानाति गुर्वी प्रसववेदनाम् [[Subhāṣ.]] 
__2 A barren cow. 
__3 A kind of perfume (बाल). 
-Comp. 
-तनयः, -पुत्रः -सुतः, or दुहिता, -सुता &c. the son or daughter of a barren woman; i. e. a wild impossibility, anything that does not and cannot exist; एष बन्ध्यासुतो याति खपुष्पकृतशेखरः; see खपुष्प.

[बन्धु स्वार्थे इदमर्थे वाऽण्] 
__1 A relation, kinsman (in general); बान्धवाः कुलमिच्छन्ति [[Subhāṣ.]]; यस्यार्थास्तस्य बान्धवाः [[

.]] 
__3 A friend; धनेभ्यः परो बान्धवो नास्ति लोके [[Subhāṣ.]] 
__4 A brother. 
__5 Friendly service (बन्धुकृत्य); पैतृष्वस्रेयप्रीत्यर्थं तद्रोत्रस्यात्तबान्धवः [[

.]] 
-Comp. 
-जनः relatives, kinsmen (taken collectively); दारिद्यात् पुरुषस्य बान्धवजनो वाक्ये न संतिष्ठते [[
